title: Workflow context for AI agents with Smartsheet MCP on AWS
summary: The Smartsheet Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server lets AI agents read, update, and act on live data. This post shows two ways to connect it on AWS: Amazon Quick for business teams and Kiro for developers, so your agents can work with Smartsheet without switching tools.
reason: AWS blog tutorial showing how to connect the Smartsheet MCP Server to Amazon Quick and Kiro. It is an integration walkthrough, not an announcement of a new model, research result, business event, policy action, or new open-source tool release; no rule condition is met.
